text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm back, y'all! I actually won the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup...!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"The fans and Hishi Ama-san both told me 
that my running got them fired up. But... 
that wasn't all!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"After the race, City declared that she's 
running in the Japan Cup! And then, and 
then... she said..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Almost like an answer to the feelings I 
told her during summer camp... She said, 
'I'll be waiting'!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, my next target race is the 
Japan Cup! I'm gonna go run right 
alongside City!"
